cohort: The study utilized placental tissues from patients with preeclampsia and healthy controls, alongside HTR8 trophoblast cells for in vitro experiments.
finding: miR-200b-3p is upregulated in the placental tissues of patients with preeclampsia and promotes the development of preeclampsia by targeting profilin 2 (PFN2).
cross-section timing: Placental tissues were collected from patients with preeclampsia and healthy controls; timing is implied to be at delivery or termination of pregnancy.
